title: Period
description: The temporal coverage of a MetricObservation. PublicSchema reifies the period as a separate class (rather than carrying inline start_date / end_date like other Event subtypes) because the SDMX and Data Cube emitters need a single URI-addressable interval to satisfy W3C Data Cube integrity constraint IC-11 (every observation has a value for every dimension, including time).

period_type.description: The kind of period: point_in_time, span, cohort, fiscal_year, or calendar_year.

start_date.description: The date on which this became effective.

end_date.description: The date on which this ceased to be effective.

granularity.description: The granularity of the period: year, quarter, month, week, day, or hour.

reference_period_type.description: An SDMX REF_PERIOD type identifier when relevant (for example, the reference week for labour force surveys, the academic year for school-attendance metrics).

observation_frequency.description: The SDMX FREQ code for this period: A (annual), Q (quarterly), M (monthly), W (weekly), D (daily), H (hourly). Carried as a single-letter code; resolves to urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.codelist.Codelist=SDMX:CL_FREQ. Named observation_frequency to avoid collision with the benefit-delivery frequency slot in schema/program.yaml.
